messages:
Maya (Design): Quick design review — the Create key modal CTAs are confusing. Primary is 'Create key' but we also have 'Create and copy', and secondary 'Create'. Users are clicking the wrong one.

Omar (PM): Yep — I saw support tickets where users lost a key because they thought 'Create' would auto-copy. We should consolidate.

Jia (Frontend): Agree. Proposal: single primary 'Create key' that returns the key + clear callout 'Copy now — this is the only time you'll see it'. Secondary action: 'Create without revealing' for tokens created server-side. Thoughts?

Maya (Design): +1. Also keyboard focus order is wrong: focus jumps from 'Key name' to 'Cancel' — should go to 'Create' after the last input. A11y nit: modal close icon lacks aria-label.

Rohan (Security): We need to ensure the 'Create without revealing' option sets a flag in the backend and shows guidance: 'This key will not be displayed again — use the export endpoint to retrieve'. Also consider adding 'last used' and 'created by' columns in the table.

Sam (Support): If we add 'last used' that'd cut support asks by ~30%. Also suggest changing empty state copy to be more action-oriented: 'No API keys yet. Create a key to start sending requests.' Add quick links to docs: /docs/keys

Jia (Frontend): Mockup of modal fields:
```
Name: [________]
Scopes: [dropdown]
Lifespan: [30 days v]
[ ] Reveal secret after create (recommended)
[Create key] [Create without revealing] [Cancel]
```
Make 'Reveal secret' checked by default with tooltip explaining risk.

Maya (Design): Copy for warning when revoking: 'Revoking this key immediately stops all requests using it. This action cannot be undone.' Button text: 'Revoke key' (danger) + confirm input 'Type REVOKE to confirm'.

Rohan (Security): Also add a faint grey 'Last used: never' indicator for new keys. For rotation flow, avoid auto-revoke older key until new key used successfully — we should suggest 'Rotate -> create new -> verify -> revoke old'. Add UI state for 'Pending rotation'.

Omar (PM): Action items: 1) Update modal CTAs and focus order (Jia + Maya) 2) Add reveal checkbox + help copy (Maya) 3) Table: add 'last used' + 'created by' (Jia) 4) Revocation confirm pattern + copy (Rohan)

Maya (Design): I'll push a Figma update by EOD with screens and a11y notes. @Jia can you pick up the focus/aria fixes?

Jia (Frontend): On it. Will also wire up the tooltip copy and ensure 'Copy now' uses clipboard API fallback.

Sam (Support): Happy to review the empty state copy + docs link wording.

Design-Bot: New design file uploaded: figma.com/file/abc123/key-modal-v2 — thumbnails attached :sparkles:

Maya (Design): Thanks!
